score_note: Sigmoid classifier score, not calibrated correctness probability.

selection.policy: Validation observed scores only: maximize recall at target precision with at least 5 detections; otherwise maximize F0.5. Matching within same cell and channel at declared physical tolerance. Stored curve may be downsampled; selection is exact.

training_provenance.sampling_policy: Every positive training candidate is visited each epoch, then reshuffled if more batches remain. Balanced reviewed negatives; optional training-only hard-negative mining. Unknown candidates never sampled.

hard_negative_mining.policy: Highest-scoring 5% of reviewed training negatives only. No validation/test or unknown candidates.
